name: 岳飞墓墓冢、墓碑与祭台
prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Asset type: Fanggu colored companion heritage plate. Image 1 is the EXACT final black ink line plate to color; preserve its silhouette, features, layout and every contour. Image 2 is a documentary photo of the exact monument for material colors. Final image is the project's matte mineral-color illustration style sample ONLY; its black background is NOT wanted. Primary request: color image 1 faithfully as an elegant museum architectural illustration. Materials and colors: Soft grass green grave mound, aged pale gray limestone tablet, altar and retaining wall, muted moss and stone weathering. Tablet remains uninscribed/abstract; do not invent readable characters. Thin charcoal outlines remain visible, restrained flat pigment planes, light natural texture only inside the solid monument; no dramatic lighting, no cast shadow. Composition: retain image 1 framing and aspect ratio. Entire outside background and truly open holes must be flat opaque PURE WHITE #FFFFFF, absolutely no black ground, gray haze, gradient, paper texture, glow, checkerboard or transparency. No people, labels, readable inscriptions, added buildings or landscape. This is a colorization, do not redesign the object.
